build_t5_model: build a T5ForConditionalGeneration model from pretrained checkpoint with configurable dropout and torch dtype
run_t5_agent: run the T5Agent with beam search generation using huggingface built-in generation for text-to-text tasks
create_t5_encoder: create a ParlaiT5Encoder module wrapping the T5Stack encoder with attention mask and device handling
create_t5_decoder: create a ParlaiT5Decoder module wrapping the T5Stack decoder with encoder state and incremental state support
configure_t5_task: configure T5 generation parameters for summarization or translation tasks using TASK_CONFIGS presets
